# Engineering Task Shape Analysis — `gastownhall/beads` @ `41f3bfe`

## Overview

`beads` (CLI name: `bd`) is a Go-based, Dolt-backed issue-tracker and work-orchestration system designed for use by agent fleets. The codebase at the cutoff SHA is large and active, with 59 schema migrations, an extensive storage conformance harness, and multiple concurrent subsystem tracks in flight. The categories below are ordered by dominance.

---

## 1. Feature

The largest cluster of work. Several substantial new capabilities are fully materialized in code.

**Work-lease system (schema v54–v55, `bd heartbeat` / `bd reclaim`)**

- Domain logic: [`internal/storage/issueops/lease.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/issueops/lease.go) — `DefaultLeaseTTL`, `freshRowLock`, `WithLeaseTTL`; [`internal/storage/issueops/stale.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/issueops/stale.go) — `GetStaleIssuesInTx` (includes heartbeat-aware NOT EXISTS check)
- Public surface: [`internal/storage/bulk_issues.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/bulk_issues.go) — `HeartbeatIssue`, `ReclaimExpiredLeases` on `BulkIssueStore`

**Conditional (CAS) update: `bd update --if-assignee` / `--if-status`**

- Implementation: [`internal/storage/issueops/update_cas.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/issueops/update_cas.go) — `CheckExpectedFieldsInTx`; new sentinels `ErrAssigneeMismatch`, `ErrStatusMismatch` in [`internal/storage/storage.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/storage.go?L36-L76)

- [`internal/storage/issueops/claim.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/issueops/claim.go) — `ClaimPoolAliasesInTx` referenced in `ClaimIssueInTx` prologue
- CHANGELOG tag: `bd-bguz6`.

- Conformance test: [`internal/storage/conformance/reclaim_scope.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/conformance/reclaim_scope.go) — `testReclaimScoped`, covering `--label`/`--label-any`/`--exclude-label`/`--assignee`/`--id` filters

## 2. Localized Bug Fix

Tightly scoped corrections to existing behaviour, each traceable to a specific incident or regression.

**CI flake: `TestProxiedServerCleanDatabases` corrupting shared test container**
- Fixed by isolating the test to a dedicated proxied server (`bdProxiedInit`) instead of the shared container. CHANGELOG tag `p1-9lf / p1-8dz`. Purely a test-isolation fix with no production logic change.

**`--purge-dropped` dropped in proxied-server mode**
- [`internal/storage/versioncontrolops/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/tree/internal/storage/versioncontrolops) (shared `DBConn` implementation). The flag was read then silently discarded before dispatch to the proxied path; also missing: batching/circuit-breaker loop, dry-run notice, `DOLT_UNDROP` trailer. CHANGELOG tag `p1-9lf`.

**Claim/unclaim refusal message steers toward holder rather than teaching eviction**
- [`internal/storage/issueops/claim.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/issueops/claim.go) refusal text. Prior message suggested `bd unclaim <id>` which, in a multi-agent fleet, caused live-claim eviction. CHANGELOG tag `bd-at6rc / wy-zs5s2`.

**Cross-type blocking dependency rejection was overly broad**
- [`internal/storage/domain/dependency.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/domain/dependency.go) — `DependencyHierarchyConflictError` replaced the blanket same-type rule with a hierarchy-deadlock guard. `conditional-blocks` previously skipped cross-type validation entirely. CHANGELOG `bd-wg7ve / #4034`.

**Verify-after-write for claim-family ops under degraded Dolt server**
- [`internal/storage/dolt/claim_verify.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/dolt/claim_verify.go) — `claimedBy`, `unclaimed`, `claimPostcondition`. Motivated by incidents `wy-ejph3` (phantom claim success) and `wy-x543k` (phantom failure). CHANGELOG tag `bd-zccb9`.

## 3. Architectural Scaffolding

Work that establishes load-bearing structures used by multiple future components.

**`HookFiringStore` storage decorator**
- [`internal/storage/hook_decorator.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/hook_decorator.go) — `HookFiringStore`, `Unwrapper`, `UnwrapStore`. Moves hook-firing from individual CLI commands into the storage layer so future commands inherit it for free. The `Unwrap`/`UnwrapStore` chain is required by other optional-interface assertions (`StoreLocator`, `BackupStore`, `Flattener`).

**`InstrumentedStorage` OTel decorator**
- [`internal/telemetry/storage.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/telemetry/storage.go) — `WrapStorage`, `InstrumentedStorage`. Wraps `DoltStorage` with OTel tracing and metrics counters/histograms/gauges for all base `Storage` interface methods.

**Narrow public interface triad: `EventQuerier`, `DependentQuerier`, `BlockedQuerier`**
- [`beads.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/beads.go?L95-L170) — hand-declared root interfaces with `As*` accessor functions and compile-time drift guards (`var _ EventQuerier = (storage.DoltStorage)(nil)` etc.). Establishes the "narrow surface / single direct assertion" contract that constrains all future decorator additions.

**Dolt file-based cross-process circuit breaker**
- [`internal/storage/dolt/circuit.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/dolt/circuit.go) — per-database-granularity circuit breaker (`circuitClosed/Open/HalfOpen` states, JSON state file in `/tmp`, `circuitStaleTTL`). Provides a fail-fast mechanism for all Dolt server paths.

**Smart remote-migrate gate**
- [`internal/storage/schema/smart_remote_migrate_gate.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/schema/smart_remote_migrate_gate.go) — `SmartGateEnv`, `LastNonDeterministicMigration = 43`. Auto-resolves provably-safe first-mover migrations; degrades to the blunt gate on ambiguity. Controlled by `BD_SMART_GATE`.

**`row_lock` serialization idiom**
- [`internal/storage/issueops/lease.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/issueops/lease.go?L41-L62) — `freshRowLock`. Because Dolt has no real row locking and merges concurrent commits cell-by-cell, every status/ownership-mutating path rewrites a shared cell to force serialization conflicts. This is a cross-cutting invariant documented in the INVARIANT comment, not a single-use fix.

## 4. Refactor

Structural changes that preserve observable behavior while reorganizing internal boundaries.

**Storage backend scope rollback (PostgreSQL/MySQL removal)**
- CHANGELOG `bd-sadcd`. PostgreSQL and MySQL adapters were rolled back before tagging. The storage interface, SQLite core, and Dolt backends remain; `configuredBackendUnavailable` in [`beads.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/beads.go?L24-L31) routes removed backends to `RemovedBackendError`. This is a deliberate scope contraction, not a bug fix.

**`clean-databases` dual topology unified under shared `DBConn`**
- The direct-server and proxied-server implementations were merged to share one code path keyed on `versioncontrolops.DBConn` (satisfiable by both `*sql.DB` and `*sql.Conn`). CHANGELOG `p1-9lf`. _Ambiguity note_: this fix also falls under localized bug fix since the immediate motivation was behavioral drift; it is listed under bug fix above but has a clear refactor character in its unification approach.

**`UpdateIssueChecked` + `MergeMetadata` promoted to required `Storage` interface**
- [`internal/storage/storage.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/storage.go) — CHANGELOG `#4911`. Previously optional/extension methods, now part of the mandatory contract. Breaking for out-of-tree implementers; noted as a breaking change.

**Wisp table routing extracted to `issueops.WispTableRouting`**
- [`internal/storage/dolt/wisps.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/dolt/wisps.go) delegates to `issueops.InsertIssueIntoTable`, `issueops.WispTableRouting`, etc. Dolt-specific wrapper functions now thin-forward to the `issueops` package, consolidating wisp/issue table routing logic in one place.

- [`internal/storage/conformance/claim.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/conformance/claim.go), [`audit_*.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/tree/internal/storage/conformance) files.

- [`beads.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/beads.go) — ~395 lines of type aliases, `var` aliases for error sentinels, and thin wrapper functions (`Open`, `FindBeadsDir`, `AsEventQuerier`, etc.). Structurally boilerplate: each addition is a rote re-export triggered by a new internal type. However, the compile-time drift guards (`var _ IssueClaimer = (storage.DoltStorage)(nil)`) are non-trivial and arguably belong under architectural scaffolding.

**Schema migration SQL files**
- [`internal/storage/schema/migrations/0001`–`0059`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/tree/internal/storage/schema/migrations) — each new feature requiring a schema change generates a pair of `.up.sql`/`.down.sql` files by convention. **Migration 0036: `cleanup_autopush_metadata`**
- [`0036_cleanup_autopush_metadata.up.sql`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/schema/migrations/0036_cleanup_autopush_metadata.up.sql) — explicit cleanup migration removing stale autopush metadata keys.

**Migration 0038: `drop_hop_columns`**, **0039: `drop_child_counters_fk`**, **0051: `drop_aux_id_defaults`**
- Removal of deprecated schema artifacts with no behavioral change.

**`dead code removal` implied by storage backend rollback** — the removed PostgreSQL/MySQL adapter code was cleanup by contraction (CHANGELOG `bd-sadcd`). _Ambiguity note_: the rollback is simultaneously refactor (boundary simplification) and cleanup (removing code that added complexity without meeting the project's resource budget).

## Taxonomy Refinement Proposals

The existing eight categories cover all observed shapes adequately, with one proposed addition:

**`concurrent-safety hardening`** — a shape that recurs prominently here but sits awkwardly across feature/bug-fix/scaffolding. The `row_lock` cell idiom ([`lease.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/issueops/lease.go?L41-L62)), the verify-after-write protocol ([`claim_verify.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/dolt/claim_verify.go)), the cross-process circuit breaker ([`circuit.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/dolt/circuit.go)), and the CAS update guards ([`update_cas.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/issueops/update_cas.go)) share a distinct pattern: they are not features (they don't add user-visible capability), not pure bug fixes (they address a class of latent hazards rather than a single reported defect), and not scaffolding (they don't establish load-bearing abstractions for future work). They are correctness investments against concurrent, distributed, or degraded-infrastructure hazard classes. Splitting them out would reduce the over-loading of "localized bug fix" and "architectural scaffolding" in repos with this character.

## Taxonomy Refinement Proposals

The existing eight categories cover all observed shapes adequately, with one proposed addition:

**`concurrent-safety hardening`** — a shape that recurs prominently here but sits awkwardly across feature/bug-fix/scaffolding. The `row_lock` cell idiom ([`lease.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/issueops/lease.go?L41-L62)), the verify-after-write protocol ([`claim_verify.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/dolt/claim_verify.go)), the cross-process circuit breaker ([`circuit.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/dolt/circuit.go)), and the CAS update guards ([`update_cas.go`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/gastownhall-beads@41f3bfe6f22d9b8b90775cae01a785d99df3f63c/-/blob/internal/storage/issueops/update_cas.go)) share a distinct pattern: they are not features (they don't add user-visible capability), not pure bug fixes (they address a class of latent hazards rather than a single reported defect), and not scaffolding (they don't establish load-bearing abstractions for future work). They are correctness investments against concurrent, distributed, or degraded-infrastructure hazard classes. Splitting them out would reduce the over-loading of "localized bug fix" and "architectural scaffolding" in repos with this character.
